normalization.loss: float64 restored output minus float64 reference; same reference units MSE
normalization.contract: 512 public windows compute their own noisy channel mean/RMS; 4096 continuous records compute one noisy full-record channel mean/RMS and restore each window as global_record_mean + prediction*global_record_rms before whole-window OLA; local window means are not reinserted and learned residual-only OLA is not used for the record path

data.public_reference: notch-conditioned recorded proxy, normalized once to reference RMS units; not physiological clean truth

training.domain_balance: equal public-record and long-continuous batches; no personal data

selection.objective: balanced corrupted MSE across public proxy and long synthetic continuous domains

research_plan.objective: test full-record noisy normalization as a slow-drift correction hypothesis while retaining v13 protected spectral behavior; no deployment or efficacy claim

training_design.long_synthetic_normalization: one full-record noisy float64 channel mean/RMS per 4096 record; restore global_record_mean + prediction*global_record_rms and OLA complete restored windows
training_design.short_public_normalization: per-window noisy float64 channel mean/RMS for 512 windows
training_design.checkpoint_selection: balanced corrupted MSE only among epochs with both domain identity gates <= 0.002

design: V14 keeps v13 50 Hz Q30 notch, 8-40 Hz plus DC protected spectral shrinkage, 512/4096 support, and signal-only forward.
The hypothesis is full-record statistics for continuous 4096 records; window-local statistics remain explicit for public 512 offline data.
process_recording computes record statistics once after notch, reuses them for all 4096/hop1024 subwindows, and overlap-adds only learned residuals.
Personal sessions, public subjects 7/8, and any real evaluation are excluded from fit and selection; formal status does not imply hardware, session, clinical, or production validation.
No checkpoint, report, manifest, lock, evaluation output, or desktop integration is produced by this implementation pass.
